name: market-research-agent
description: AI Financial Research Platform for Crypto & US Stocks

scripts.dev:agent: cd services/agent && uv run uvicorn agent_service.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.py:lint: cd services/agent && uv run ruff check .
scripts.py:format: cd services/agent && uv run ruff format .
scripts.py:test: cd services/agent && uv run pytest -m 'not live'
scripts.check: pnpm gen:types && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm py:lint && pnpm py:typecheck && pnpm py:test
